verdict.rationale: Tavily's core operations take natural-language input. Search and research accept plain-language questions and topics, crawl accepts "natural language instructions for the crawler", and the official MCP server and Agent Skills let users drive search, extract, crawl, map and research by talking to Claude, Cursor or Codex. Docs also say a coding agent can install and configure Tavily from a single instruction. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation (only one brief community mention), and no evidence of natural-language control over account management, usage or configuration beyond the agent-setup skill.
